integration.scope: Radio-wide historical wildcard and a separately queried SOME-messages historical aggregate; row-specific incarnation diagnostics deliberately unavailable
integration.actual_consumer: AppChatsContent direct conversation calls the actual AppChatConversationScreen notice slot
integration.actual_owner: AppChatsFeature owns one lazy inert monitor combining actual SessionRegistry.currentSessions and currentRadioId; keyed LaunchedEffect idempotently starts it after composition
integration.mounted_owner_fence: AppChatsContent lifecycle-collects currentSessions and currentRadioId independently of monitor.state; actual current graph reference/token/radio fences checked text before the monitor handles replacement
integration.lifetime: Child SupervisorJob of existing UI/process scope, graph identity/token/radio/epoch replacement and cancellation
integration.unexpected_failure: Original uncaught observer cause reaches CoroutineExceptionHandler and existing AppChatsFeature.report; unrelated graph children remain supervised
integration.freshness: Radio observer and one graph-owned serial message-query worker poll only while their current ownership/registrations are active. Each message batch waits 1000ms after completion. No per-commit or latency-bound guarantee.
integration.copy: Some messages may have been sent; confirmation for some new messages may remain unavailable indefinitely and sending remains possible. All 12 locales generated from attributed Android-only copy.
integration.layout: Scrollable notice uses at most half the weighted conversation viewport; composer and its IME/navigation inset space are measured separately. No truncation or fixed text height.
integration.held_graph_producer_contract: Uses existing main currentSessions, preserves publication and registry implementations
integration.message_status_projection: Every outgoing non-channel FAILED DTO uses identity-independent delivery-unconfirmed/may-have-sent text in both actual ChatTimeline visible/fallback semantics and App custom cached-footer accessibility. No store/status/footer/send/retry mutation. Actual DTO DELIVERED remains delivered, including when a cached footer says FAILED.
integration.message_aggregate: Current loaded outgoing non-delivered DM keys are registered once per mounted consumer, unioned and radio-filtered. Optional canonical b204/009 query is serial, cancellation/request/graph-fenced and independent from wildcard-only radio observation. Any nonempty Present can raise only a radio-scoped SOME-messages historical warning; Missing/NotEligible/errors never supply a green result or clear known same-radio history.
integration.incarnation_boundary: No atomic timeline row+incarnation binding exists. Returned diagnostic identity/revision/status/reasons are NEVER attached to a rendered row, cached footer, mutation argument or delivery assertion. Ordinary DTO/key equality cannot establish binding; explicit message-specific unavailable copy remains visible even after successful reads.
integration.strict_history: Coordinator provisional strict fresh+upgrade external/preauthority-history policy, not a user-selected option. PREAUTHORITY_HISTORY_UNKNOWN is consumed as its actual typed radio wildcard; no fake wire, SATURATED alias, TTL, reconnect reset or clean-fresh-install claim.
integration.reporter_gap: Transient DirectAckNonsettlementException and preclaim reports are not complete durable message evidence

custody_and_admission.inspection: Read exact public held diffs without waking or inspecting paused sessions. Coordinator separately allocated main-only integration; 13a confirms no App/timeline/UI changes.
custody_and_admission.disposition: Existing App consumers and ChatTimeline status presentation receive bounded monitor/slot/layout/status changes. Held send, scroll, notification, registry and runtime-publication logic is unchanged. Shared-file composition still requires exact review.
custody_and_admission.locale_copy_and_outputs: Existing attributed generator-input and generated-resources rules, all locales regenerated

cases: Actual ContainerHarness App feature shares monitor across consumers and replaces graph ownership
Unexpected graph observer exception marks unavailable, logs original cause and preserves sibling work
Missing actual store capability stays explicit without fake NoWildcard
mounted_app_cases: Actual direct warning, missing capability, channel non-subscription and Activity recreation
Mounted same-radio new-token, different-radio and disconnected owner with the monitor dispatcher frozen at old NoWildcard and replacement read gated; replacement skips the disconnected frame
Actual stored FAILED direct visible/fallback semantics, unchanged DELIVERED and unchanged FAILED channel
Identical-field actual Room delete/recreate while diagnostic fixture query is paused: no diagnostic identity can be attached to a row, only aggregate uncertainty and explicit row-unavailable copy
Custom cached FAILED footer never overrides conservative FAILED wording or actual DTO DELIVERED; cached item and DTO unchanged
Typed PREAUTHORITY_HISTORY_UNKNOWN notice explains indefinite uncertainty and retains editable composer
Double-font actual failed direct row retains composer and retry reachability
aggregate_cases: All direction/channel/status combinations for conservative failure text without DTO mutation
Missing capability, serial radio-filtered known-code query and 1000ms post-batch delay
Missing/NotEligible, same-radio disconnect and typed errors retain known historical uncertainty
Late noncancellable old-radio read cannot affect replacement graph
Unknown failure escapes unchanged under supervisor and preserves unrelated sibling
Overlapping mounted registrations share one serial read and release only their own keys
source_controls.fixture_limit: Message identities/collision and preauthority observations in mounted consumer controls are deterministic protocol fixtures, not proof of storage SQL, migration, reopen or physical provenance. Exact producer composition and real restart/migration controls remain required.

not_run: Room migration/reopen composed with the new query producer
execution.next_gate: Independent exact-source review and full dependency composition before hosted execution
